An '''individual''' was a member of the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the individual betrayed the [[Ruling Synod]] of Bakura and enabled [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to slay the entire Synod.
